verdict.rationale: The spec and docs define a skill as a directory with a `SKILL.md` file: YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, with optional scripts/references/assets folders. Anthropic positions this as an open standard for cross-platform portability. A hands-on probe installed an official skill via third-party tooling with no Anthropic account and read back plain spec-conformant markdown. A community developer also adapted the repo's skills into a model-agnostic setup running on Gemini. Missing for 10: evidence of a named non-Anthropic harness natively loading an unmodified skill folder (the Gemini port required adaptation).
